patterns.note: The page primarily uses a dark mode aesthetic with full-bleed sections, alternating between solid black backgrounds and dark gray textured backgrounds for content blocks.
Headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, creating a strong visual hierarchy, often paired with smaller, uppercase labels or subheadings for context.
A core palette of black, white, and various shades of dark gray is accented by vibrant, saturated colors like yellow, blue, and green for calls to action and interactive elements.
The initial full-bleed video hero dynamically transitions to a static black background with the main headline and CTA as the user scrolls down, before scrolling completely out of view.
A promotional banner appears at the very top of the page after a slight scroll, then disappears as the user scrolls further down the page.
Content sections below the hero appear to reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a guided scrolling experience.
Interactive-looking content blocks, such as image generation input fields and feature cards, are presented within distinct, full-width dark sections.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed video that dynamically transitions to a static dark background with the main headline and call to action upon initial scroll, then scrolls away to reveal subsequent content. This creates a layered, dynamic introduction.
A temporary, dismissible banner is revealed at the top of the page after a short scroll, providing timely promotions, and then scrolls out of view or is dismissed.
Content sections throughout the page are revealed with a staggered animation, such as a subtle fade-in or slide-up, as they enter the user's viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong impact, complemented by clean, legible body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons and input fields, while most large content blocks maintain sharp edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with an airy, expansive hero section and subsequent content sections featuring a more structured grid layout for features and cards.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic hero section, which transforms significantly on scroll from a full-bleed video collage to a focused text-based hero, and then seamlessly transitions into an interactive input field. This creates a highly engaging and progressive introduction to the product without requiring user interaction.
